evidence.note: Fresh TypeScript build passed at current HEAD after DONE guard integration, quorum diagnostic wiring, and reviewer metadata commits.

entries.desc: Logic test builds a story with no changed docs/requirements/decisions/*.md against main...HEAD; the quorum detector returns not-applicable and DONE is not blocked by missing host_verdict events.

evidence.note: Smoke covers no docs/requirements/decisions/*.md change against main...HEAD; report applicable=false and ok=true, so DONE is not blocked.

entries.desc: CLI or guard test attempts story_advance --phase=DONE with prose-only evidence, duplicate hosts, duplicate rounds, or stale material digest; the gate blocks and names the missing or invalid round, host, and digest facts instead of accepting text evidence.

entries.desc: CLI check feeds unsigned, prose-only, wrong-story, wrong-HEAD, or stale host_verdict events into the diagnostic path; output refuses a pass result and explains which events were ignored or invalid.

entries.desc: Focused tests exercise missing host_verdict events, insufficient hosts, insufficient rounds, and stale material digest with deterministic builders, and each case asserts the gate remains blocking with the expected diagnostic reason.

entries.desc: Regression test review verifies the suite would fail if the DONE gate accepted duplicate hosts, duplicate rounds, stale digests, or prose-only evidence as structured host_verdict quorum.

entries.desc: Logic or docs check verifies the process fact registry and verify-process-fact-contract script register the host_verdict quorum as a gate-consumed L4 workflow fact with the DONE gate consumer, while leaving runtime-only facts out of the process registry.

entries.desc: Docs/registry review rejects any implementation where host_verdict quorum is described only as advisory memory, prose evidence, or optional review guidance, or where the registry omits the signed/gate-consumed artifact semantics.
